Class RoutingStrategy

java.lang.Object
NetStrategies.RoutingStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCheck
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClassSwitchRoutingStrategy, DisabledRoutingStrategy, EmpiricalStrategy, FastestServiceRoutingStrategy, LeastUtilizationRoutingStrategy, LoadDependentRoutingStrategy, PropertyBasedStrategy, RandomStrategy, RoundRobinStrategy, ShortestQueueLengthRoutingStrategy, ShortestResponseTimeRoutingStrategy, WeightedRoundRobinStrategy
public abstract class RoutingStrategy extends Object implements AutoCheck
Use this class to implement a specific routing strategy. A routing strategy is a rule which selects an output node from a node list.
Author:
Francesco Radaelli, Bertoli Marco 13-11-2005 (Added job class), Das Ashanka 11-2011 (Added getOutNode with NodeSection).
